title: Local bijectivity of a determinant wedge morphism
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C$ a short complex of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, and $r_2=r_1+r_3$. Suppose $A,C$ are finite locally free of ranks $r_1,r_3$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Let $\varphi:(\bigwedge^{r_1}A)\otimes(\bigwedge^{r_3}C)\to\bigwedge^{r_2}B$ satisfy the following wedge formula, using [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]: on every open $V$, for all tuples a,b,c with $g(c_i)=b_i$, its value on $(\bigwedge a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge b_i)$ is $\bigwedge(f(a_1),\ldots,f(a_{r_1}),c_1,\ldots,c_{r_3})$. Suppose $U\subseteq X$ admits an isomorphism $e:B|_U\simeq A|_U\oplus C|_U$ with $e\circ f|_U=\mathrm{inl}$ and $\mathrm{pr}_2\circ e=g|_U$. Then $\varphi(W)$ is bijective for every open $W\subseteq U$. No exactness away from $U$ and no finite locally free hypothesis on $B$ are assumed.

proof.text: The inverse splitting composed with the second inclusion is a right inverse to the restricted quotient. Evaluate its right-inverse identity on every open of U, then use U.image(U.preimage(W))=W for W contained in U. This proves sectionwise surjectivity of g on every W contained in U. The fully proved private helper split_quotient_section_surjective implements the argument. Set l_W=Function.surjInv of this proved surjectivity.

Apply determinant_split_comparison_exists to these lifts. At every point it supplies a neighborhood V and a natural family of linear equivalences on the canonical exteriorPower sheaves, with the concatenated-wedge formula for those lifts.

The wedge formula of phi and that of d_W give equality on tensors of pure wedges, since g(l_W(b))=b. Extend first in the second exterior factor and then in the first using exteriorPower.ιMulti_span, linearity, local surjectivity of the exterior sheafification unit, and separatedness. Extend to arbitrary tensor sheaf sections by local surjectivity of the tensor sheafification unit and TensorProduct.induction_on. Naturality of d_W and phi verifies local closure. This is the fully proved private helper bijective_of_comparison, using generated_sheafification_induction, tensor_section_induction and local_comparison_eq. Thus phi is bijective on every subopen of each neighborhood V.

For arbitrary W contained in U, equal-image sections become equal on W intersected with each comparison neighborhood, by its local injectivity. Separatedness proves global injectivity. Form the covering sieve of subopens on all of whose subopens phi is bijective. For a target section choose its preimage on every member of this sieve using the proved local surjectivity. Naturality and the global injectivity just proved imply compatibility of these preimages under all overlap maps. Amalgamate the family by the source sheaf axiom; naturality and separatedness of the target show its image is the desired section. This is bijective_of_locally_bijective. It also treats the empty open by the empty-cover sheaf axiom.

lean.statement:
theorem determinant_wedgeMorphism_bijective_of_split {X : Scheme.{v}}
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃)
    [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁] [S.X₃.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₃]
    (φ : exteriorPower S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorPower S.X₃ r₃ ⟶ exteriorPower S.X₂ r₂)
    (hφ : ∀ (V : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op V))
      (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op V)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op V)),
      (∀ i, S.g.val.app (op V) (c i) = b i) →
      φ.val.app (op V)
        (tmulSection (wedge (M := S.X₁) (r := r₁) (U := V) a)
          (wedge (M := S.X₃) (r := r₃) (U := V) b)) =
        wedge (M := S.X₂) (r := r₂) (U := V)
          (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op V) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i)))
    (U : X.Opens)
    (e : S.X₂.restrict U.ι ≅ S.X₁.restrict U.ι ⊞ S.X₃.restrict U.ι)
    (hf : (restrictFunctor U.ι).map S.f ≫ e.hom = biprod.inl)
    (hg : e.hom ≫ biprod.snd = (restrictFunctor U.ι).map S.g) :
    ∀ W ≤ U, Function.Bijective (φ.app W)
